rules.message: iret handler entry: expected push cs / pop ds / push bp (0E 1F 55); found {prefix}
rules.rationale: canonical NMI handler prologue; DS self-sufficient, BP preserved per Rule 1 S1 v1

rules.message: iret handler must contain no far RETF (CB); found {count}, expected 0. NMI handlers return via IRET
rules.rationale: NMI entry pushes FLAGS/CS/IP; only IRET restores them; RETF returns into a corrupt frame

rules.message: iret handler must contain exactly one IRET (CF); found {count}, expected 1
rules.rationale: single NMI exit path; an early IRET would skip the latch clear

rules.message: iret handler epilogue: expected pop bp / iret (5D CF); found {suffix}
rules.rationale: restore BP before IRET per Rule 1
